crossRefs.note: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?
“To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.
Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,
Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.
Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,
There is no one like you, Yahweh. You are great, and your name is great in might.
Who shouldn’t fear you, King of the nations? For it belongs to you. Because among all the wise men of the nations, and…
The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance…
who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his…

translations.web: “To whom will you compare me, and consider my equal, and compare me, as if we were the same?
translations.bsb: To whom will you liken Me or count Me equal? To whom will you compare Me, that we should be alike?
translations.kjv: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?
translations.asv: To whom will ye like me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?
